summary: Iter-36: 4 menu enhancements verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 new pytest tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter36_menu_enhancements.py) covering (1) counter column in template (8 headers) + parsed correctly through both vendor bulk-upload flow and admin direct upload; (2) PATCH /api/admin/menu-uploads/{id}/items — edit price / drop items / change counter / RBAC 403 for vendor + employee, 400 after approve, live menu reflects edits & dropped items removed after approve; (3) GET /api/admin/menu-uploads?status=decided returns rows with decided_by/decided_at/decision_note/vendor_name/item_count and vendor is 403; (4) Approval notification best-effort — approve + reject both return 200 with Resend configured. Regression: full previous suite still passes (20/20 test_menu_bulk_approval.py). Frontend Playwright on /master/sites/{SITE_A} Menu tab: approval-history-card, toggle-history-btn, history-search (filters correctly: matching term → shows rows, non-matching → 0 rows), history-row-{id} all present (15 decided rows). edit-upload-{id} button expands editable table with edit-name-{idx}/edit-price-{idx}/edit-counter-{idx}/edit-remove-{idx} + save-edit-{id}; edit + save succeeded; approve after edit succeeded with green 'Upload approved — menu is now live' confirmation. Vendor submit UI with counter column also succeeded (rej.xlsx pending → approved).

design_issues.screen: Master SiteDetail Menu tab — 'Upload Menu via Excel' card helper text
issues: Helper text still lists optional columns as 'is_vegetarian, image_url, meal_periods (comma-separated)' — does NOT mention the new optional 'counter' column. Minor doc drift; template itself carries the 8-column header correctly.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Update helper text under 'Upload Menu via Excel' card in master/SiteDetail to mention optional 'counter' column.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_edit_menu_upload_items correctly (a) requires pending status → 400 otherwise, (b) enforces master/site-access RBAC → 403 for vendor+employee, (c) dedupes by lower(name), (d) validates price>=0 with 400 on non-numeric, (e) rewrites item_count. Good.
_notify_vendor_menu_decision is fully wrapped in try/except so email failure never breaks the approve/reject API. Correct best-effort semantics.
admin_list_menu_uploads with status='decided' expands to $in:[approved,rejected] and joins vendor name. decided_at is emitted only if set — for backfilled pre-iter36 rows it will be None; acceptable.

parse_menu_workbook + upload_menu_excel both read the optional 'counter' column identically (headers.index lookup w/ None fallback). No duplication risk. MENU_TEMPLATE_HEADERS is the single source of truth.
GET /menu/{vendor_id} projection now includes 'counter' (server.py ~1267). Verified via approve → live menu contains counter values.

Minor: after PATCH items, no version snapshot is recorded (snapshots are only on approve/replace). Since the pending doc itself is updated in place, this is fine; if later requirement asks for edit history, add an audit trail on menu_upload_requests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all new data-testids resolved & flow works
